name: OneDrive
description: Resolves OneDrive and SharePoint files and sharing links through Microsoft Graph.

account.secret_hint: Nothing to paste here. OneDrive is signed in at Microsoft itself: enter your application (client) ID above, start the sign-in, and agree in the browser window that opens — or type the short code shown at microsoft.com/devicelogin on any other screen.
account.username_hint: OneDrive needs an application registration of your own — this project ships none, so that every installation has its own Microsoft throttling budget. In the Microsoft Entra admin center (entra.microsoft.com) under App registrations, create a registration for accounts in any organisational directory and personal Microsoft accounts, add the platform Mobile and desktop applications with http://127.0.0.1:8710/api/v1/oauth/callback as its redirect URI, switch Allow public client flows on for the device sign-in, and paste the Application (client) ID here. The sign-in asks for Files.Read.All and offline_access only. Nothing is pasted into the secret field: the sign-in fills it.

codes.onedrive.access_denied: This account may not access this OneDrive item. The link may have been shared with another account or tenant
codes.onedrive.download_not_permitted: This item may be viewed but not downloaded — a policy of the SharePoint site or tenant blocks the download
codes.onedrive.invalid_request: OneDrive could not resolve this sharing link. It may belong to a tenant this account cannot reach
codes.onedrive.is_a_folder: This OneDrive address is a folder. Add it again to let the folder be listed
codes.onedrive.item_not_found: This OneDrive item does not exist, the sharing link was withdrawn, or this account cannot see it
codes.onedrive.malware_detected: OneDrive flagged this file as malware and will not serve it
codes.onedrive.not_a_file: This OneDrive item is not a file that can be downloaded
codes.onedrive.not_a_onedrive_link: This is not a OneDrive or SharePoint file address
codes.onedrive.rate_limited: OneDrive is rate limiting this account
codes.onedrive.sign_in_required: This OneDrive account has to be signed in again
